journal.thisEntryReversed: This entry has been reversed. It stays posted and the reversal offsets it.
journal.thisEntryVoided: This entry has been voided by a reversal dated on the same day.
journal.reverseDescription: A new posted entry will offset this one line by line. The original stays posted and is marked as reversed.
journal.reversalDateHint: Leave empty to use the original date (or today if that period is locked).
journal.voidDescription: A reversal dated on the original date will cancel this entry. This cannot be undone.
journal.sentForApprovalBody: This entry is above the approval limit. Another user must approve it.
journal.coaParentHelp: Group this account under another account of the same type. Parents roll up their children in the indented view.
journal.coaParentFailed: Could not change the parent account
journal.pageDescription: Double-entry journal with automatic balance validation
journal.emptyDescription: Record your first manual journal entry — every transaction needs at least one debit and one credit.
